Figure

primers
were

screened

of
segments

DNA
from
two
different

Botryllus
samples ,
one
taken
from
Bodega
Bay
and
one
from
the
Santa
Cruz
marina .

For
some
of
the
primers ,
most
of
the
bands
which
were
amplified
from
one
sample

were
also
amplified
from
the
other ,
but
for
other
primers
several
bands
were
pro-

duced
for
one
sample
and
none
for
the
other .
A
total
of
37
different
bands
were
de-

tected .
All
primers
were
also
used
in
control
reactions
without
genomic
DNA ;
no

primer
artefacts
were
observed .
Thus ,
it
would
appear
that
genetic
differences
can
be

distinguished
using
this
technique .
Ten
other
primers
( data
not

also

screened

these
results

none

any
significant
amplification
